"Scaling of Xiaomi's smart factories for appliances and smartphones, together with embodied robots already achieving around a 98% task success rate in EV production and about 90% in logistics sorting, can create a structural drop in unit manufacturing costs that supports higher long term gross margins and operating margins across hardware lines."

It sells phones, computers and wearables, but the real focus is what people do on them. Subscriptions, cloud tools and financial features can turn occasional buyers into steadier customers.
